content: New research thread opened 2026-05-18: cannabis and human biology, built on the same rigor discipline as the prior CBD two-pathway model. Architecture decided with Anthony: SYSTEMS-FIRST spine (ECS as organizing axis: CB1, CB2, AEA/2-AG, FAAH/MAGL, then non-CB targets TRPV1/GPR55/PPARs/5-HT1A), TIERED-EVIDENCE LEDGER gate with a HARD LANGUAGE RULE: no benefit-to-humanity claim without adequate human clinical evidence. Five tiers, strictly walled: human RCT/meta-analysis (clinical benefit language permitted) > human observational (association/signal/pattern only) > mechanistic/ex vivo (plausible pathway only) > animal/cell (hypothesis only) > anecdotal/cultural (context not proof). Negative/null/mixed evidence preserved at equal prominence to positive. First-pass extended-research report completed and delivered as artifact. Reframed central question, locked: NOT what is cannabis good for, but what does it interact with in human biology, what evidence supports each claimed effect, what risks travel with those effects, where are we on hypothesis vs proof.
